C01.name: Manufacturing, Industrial & Automation
C01.description: Make products in factories — run machines, robots and quality checks.
C01.futureBottomLine: Factories are automating; jobs go to people who can run and fix automated machines.
C01.parentNote: Myth: “Factory jobs are low-skill” — automated plants need trained technicians. ITI plus apprenticeship lets students earn while they learn.
